description: This file contains code for an AI-based code review tool that uses language models and external tools to analyze code diffs and provide review feedback. It defines an import of external libraries, a prompt template, and a class 'AiCodeReviewer' that manages the review process.

classes.name: AiCodeReviewer
classes.description: A class that manages the process of reviewing code diffs using a language model and external tools, including initialization with an API key and an asynchronous review method.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the AiCodeReviewer with an API key, setting up the language model.

methods.name: review
methods.description: Asynchronously reviews a code diff by invoking the language model with the prompt and tools, returning the review feedback as a string.
